message: 勤労少女のプライド

name: Synn
message: 「I think I'll help out at the shops today for the first time in a while」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you gonna do about Student Council work」

name: Synn
message: 「Interacting with the folks in the shopping district is important for making KiraFes a success, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that's true」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, since I quit my part-time job, I've been itching to work for a while now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got a pretty unprofitable nature, you know that」

name: Synn
message: 「I do it because I like it, so it's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, what are you up to, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me? I finished my work for today, so I figured I'd come mess with you a bit, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm」
Still, the great thing about Nanaka is that she ends up helping out anyway, despite saying stuff like that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, where are we helping out today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Kim-san mentioned the other day that he was short-handed」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Five-Star Hanten, then. Got it」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey there~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Welcome~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, it's just Mako-chan」

name: Macaron
message: 「Gah! Big Brother!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, did you start working part-time at Kim-san's place?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um, well, something like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, look at you! So admirable at such a young age」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mgh, why are you acting so high and mighty...」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Welcome, Synn and Nanaka, aru ne」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Mr. Kim」

name: Kim-san
message: 「What will your order be, aru ka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're not customers today, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「We thought we'd help out for the first time in a while」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Well, thank you for that, ne」

name: Kim-san
message: 「It's alright though, aru yo. Macaron's filling in for me right now, ne」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, looks like they're counting on you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, yeah!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's heavy lifting too, you know--will you be okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, don't underestimate me! I'm totally confident in my stamina」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, you're pretty amazing」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, we-ell, yeah!」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Macaron is full of energy and good with her hands, ne」

name: Kim-san
message: 「She's just as hard a worker as you, Synn, aru yo」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm wa~ay more of a hard worker than Big Brother!」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Aiya, how rude of me, aru ne」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha. Looks like they don't really need our help after all」

name: Macaron
message: 「O-bviously! Why don't you just go home and take a nap or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hearing you say that suddenly makes me wanna help out!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm. Big Sis Nanaka, was it? Are you trying to compete with me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet! I haven't been Synn's childhood friend all this time for nothing!」

name: Synn
message: 「That has nothing to do with it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't be so cold!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph. You're just gonna side with your childhood friend anyway, Big Brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, I mean」

name: Macaron
message: 「I knew it, you won't take my side at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, whose side are you on anyway!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, even if you ask me whose side...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother! I'm being serious here!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you trying to blow off your childhood friend?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Er, no, I'll properly support both of you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...That doesn't count as 'properly'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, you're so indecisive」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, was that even what this contest was about?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Boo... Dummy」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Um... sorry?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! I'm heading back to help out at home!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's settle once and for all who's the hardest worker in the shopping district!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph! Don't come crying to me when you lose!」

name: Synn
message: 「How are you supposed to decide that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just leave the judging up to Synn however he sees fit!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really okay」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, time to give it my all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, she's gone」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Is that what childhood friends are like?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I wonder. I think Nanaka is on the reckless side, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have any childhood friends or anything, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nope. I don't have friends like that. So I don't really get it」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「B-But, I do have a super cool master whom I respect!」

name: Synn
message: 「A master? That's amazing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right? They took care of me when I was in the Demon World」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm sure they're still watching over my accomplishments from somewhere right now」

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon World...」
Macaron really is a Demon, after all.
Even though we can talk normally like this...

name: Kim-san
message: 「Macaron-chan. You can go ahead and take your break now」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, oka~y」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since you started working part-time here, did you already quit Uncle Amakawa's place?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah... Not really, I haven't quit」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that's good」

name: Macaron
message: 「My motto is to see things through to the very end once I decide to do them!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's true. I think you're amazing, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「The hours don't overlap, anyway. So it's not that tough」

name: Synn
message: 「Gotcha. Still, you shouldn't push yourself too hard」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not overdoing it. I'm totally fine!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I'm gonna be the Demon Lord, being able to do this much is just a given!」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, why do you want to become the Demon Lord?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh...? Well, um...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-It's a secret! I'm not telling you」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even a little?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm definitely not telling a big brother who bullies demons...!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not bullying them」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just warning the demons who are causing trouble for everyone」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「We aren't fighting because we hate demons or anything like that」

name: Synn
message: 「We just don't want them to disturb the peace in this town」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Then I'll do it」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll scold the demons playing pranks and keep them in line」

name: Macaron
message: 「And that way, I'll make all the demons recognize that I'm the Demon Lord and the greatest of them all」

name: Macaron
message: 「So don't get in my way, big brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then we won't have to fight anymore...」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright, break's over. Gotta work hard!」

name: Macaron
message: 「See ya, big brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. Good luck at your part-time job」

name: Macaron
message: 「Of course! I'm not gonna lose to your childhood friend, either!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, looks like I don't need to worry」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Ehehe」

name: Synn
message: 「'Don't get in the way,' huh」
I hope things can just stay peaceful like this with Macaron.

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I can tell her I'm the real Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's no point forcing myself to think about it」
First, let's tackle the problems right in front of me one by one.
When that time comes, I'm sure things will work out somehow.
